# Location scope (a location with marks, at the Locations group's look): the marks of a building category go
# (a save from before 2026-11-10 evening; a mark is a good or a building now), quietly, each off the count.
pp_lplan_drop_categories = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_trade_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_trade_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_trade_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_trade_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_government_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_government_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_government_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_government_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_military_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_military_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_military_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_military_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_defense_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_defense_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_defense_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_defense_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_religious_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_religious_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_religious_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_religious_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_cultural_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_cultural_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_cultural_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_cultural_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_naval_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_naval_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_naval_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_naval_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_c_infrastructure_category }
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_c_infrastructure_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_st_c_infrastructure_category
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_est_c_infrastructure_category
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_lplan_n }
			change_variable = { name = pp_lplan_n subtract = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = pp_lplan_n
			var:pp_lplan_n < 100.5
		}
		remove_variable = pp_lplan_n
	}
}

# Any scope, never run (pp_lplan_select calls it under always = no): declares the flags the window passes, sets
# the marks only an older save holds (they are only ever removed) and reads the mark states only the GUI reads,
# so the script check logs no 'used but never set' line for them.
pp_lplan_declare_flags = {
	set_variable = { name = pp_lplan_flag value = flag:camels }
	set_variable = { name = pp_lplan_flag value = flag:elephants }
	set_variable = { name = pp_lplan_flag value = flag:horses }
	set_variable = { name = pp_lplan_flag value = flag:livestock }
	set_variable = { name = pp_lplan_flag value = flag:wool }
	set_variable = { name = pp_lplan_flag value = flag:beeswax }
	set_variable = { name = pp_lplan_flag value = flag:dyes }
